capture_scope: one complete 240-frame NTSC splash, including silence, cue events, menu handoff and audio teardown
required_artifacts: dedicated BlastEm screenshot of the visual signature
save.sram and visual_vdp_dump.bin tied to the same ROM and capture session
audio recording or directly listenable capture preserving the complete signal
runtime_metrics.json with scene id, audio update cadence, cue events and over-budget counters
rules: A screenshot or metadata cannot approve audio quality.
Audio quality requires a human listener and the same hash-bound ROM used for runtime evidence.
Any rebuild invalidates capture artifacts bound to the previous ROM hash.
